states.DESIGNED: Documented target; not evidence of implementation.
states.TESTED: Automated or manual test evidence exists.
states.LIVE: Observed from the running production source.
states.VERIFIED: LIVE evidence was checked against an authoritative source.
states.STALE: Previously verified but freshness window expired.
states.UNAVAILABLE: Required source cannot currently be reached.
states.UNKNOWN: The platform deliberately refuses to infer the value.

rules: A failed read is not zero.
An empty query is not proof of absence.
Derived values retain lineage to their inputs.
Provider state must be independently verified.
Consequential AI output is not authoritative without evidence and authorization.
